supplementary_direct_checks.detail: November 17 six-fatality roundup; two previously uncaptured fatalities distinguished from four earlier logged deaths.

November 17 joint statement already recorded in prior watch; excluded as duplicate.

excluded_candidates: Four deaths in November 17 WAFA aggregate: two Deir al-Balah shooting deaths, one Khan Younis airstrike fatality and one Bir al-Na'ja airstrike fatality already captured by earlier watches.
Reuters November 17 IOM winter warning and 100,000 tents awaiting entry reflect an already-recorded WFP/IOM alert and ongoing access problems; not counted as a new access policy.
Reuters reference to 9-month-old suspected hypothermia victim on November 12 is older and lacks confirmation it was missed by prior watches; exclude as a new finding in this narrow window.
November 16 PCHR field report includes older November 12–15 events, outside immediate evidence of a new qualifying uncaptured development.
West Bank-only articles, political sanctions without verified Gaza access changes, opinion and unsupported claims excluded.
limitations: WHO EMRO returned HTTP 502; OCHA OPT and WHO Global accessible, so coverage was usable but DEGRADED.
news.un.org was blocked by robots.txt in targeted results; reporting accessed through other official sites.
No independent verification of the two additional fatalities beyond WAFA English and Arabic editions of the same report.
Source publication hour was presented in WAFA site local time, without an explicit timezone; both reports dated November 17, 2026.
Exactly twelve targeted searches following first OCHA/WHO checks, no further web searches.
No production, publication, approvals or scheduling changes.
coverage_notes.overall: Two distinct fatalities in WAFA's November 17 six-death roundup were not present in previous hourly four-death watch: a Rafah militia gunfire death and delayed death from a Hafsa School strike in Jabalia. Regional WHO access remains degraded.
